description: This file defines a Polymer custom element named `iron-selector`, which manages a list of elements with selection capabilities. It imports necessary dependencies, includes documentation, and registers a Polymer element with behaviors for multi-selection.

classes.name: iron-selector
classes.description: A Polymer custom element for managing selectable list items, supporting index or attribute-based selection, with styling for the selected item.

methods.name: Polymer
methods.description: Initializes and registers the Polymer element named 'iron-selector' with specified behaviors.
